body:
16 Nov 2026, ADVISOR'S RULINGS on helper-p229b's two questions (notes 5b96 and 491b; PR #107 is P2-29's one PR, code lands on its branch, do not merge #107 alone).
Q1 THE CLOSED-APP CARD: the 15 Nov 23:19 condition of Q1 ("the single card must not remove the phone-copy card when the app is killed") is WITHDRAWN: it assumed foreground WorkManager work with its own card; helper-p229b read the code and there is none (no Config.runInForeground, no configure call, only the mediaPlayback foreground type; the copies are ordinary workers; after a kill at most maxInFlight = 4 files finish). Verified by the lead with grep on main 102d068. RULING: OPTION B. One card, owned by Dart. Outside the app (from the moment the person leaves it) the card uses the DRAWN DATED wording and is refreshed while the phone lets Encore run; it freezes truthfully when the process is killed. Why: on a Samsung a backgrounded app with no music is frozen or killed early; a live card that is only right while refreshes keep coming would often be stale or gone = the 'no notification' complaint again. Every card shown outside the app is worded so that freezing leaves it TRUE (no reason such as 'resting until' or 'waiting for Wi-Fi' on the lock screen; those are in-app only). CONDITIONS: (1) drawing first, same PR: amend S-95's captions (and any frame that shows a live reason on the lock screen) with the existing dated wording, NO new sentence; (2) state the COST in PB-38 and ADR-R44 (outside the app the card shows no reasons; with the app killed the copy stops after the files in flight; revisit trigger = N-40); (3) fix the transport's 'survive process death' comment; (4) the audit row is B-135 and the item N-40 'A download keeps going after you close the app' (both filed 16 Nov; â‰¤4-file tail and Notifications.kt:629 are READ, not run); (5) leave the 6-hourly periodic job OUT of this slice (posting from the background isolate is not needed); (6) tests: pausing/leaving posts the dated card with no timeout; resuming brings the live card back on the SAME id; a foreground crash with a live card times out (timeoutAfter).
Q2 ARABIC: OPTION 1. English now; every card sentence is ONE whole-message function with named parameters ('and N more' takes a count, never glued from fragments); the English words live in one table so gen-l10n can take them later mechanically. S-95's Arabic stays as the fixture of the new item N-41 'The app speaks Arabic first (localisation)' (LATER list). No second ad-hoc i18n layer (a cost to the future).
TWO CHECKS FOR THE BUILD: (a) FIND which import path the Import screen of build 160 calls (EncoreImport = the Encore server's, or the legacy ImportsController). The item exists because of the owner's own import of 6 Nov: if his tap goes through ImportsController, covering only EncoreImport does not answer his report and P2-29 cannot be marked built; cover what his tap uses (and say so). (b) Prefer the server's live event `import.progress` (flat: importId, state, total, matched, unmatched, pending, kept) with a `GET imports` resync on (re)connect, the way keep.progress works, instead of a new always-on poller; correct docs/17 section 4 to what the server sends, with a test pinning the shape. Not a blocker; the default.
FOR THE OWNER (information): if you swipe Encore away during a download this week, the copy to the phone stops after the files already in flight until you open the app again. A known gap, item N-40.
